title: Tuscan White Bean and Kale Soup
summary: Rustic Tuscan soup with creamy white beans, tender kale, garlic and rosemary.
ingredients: 2 x 400 g tins cannellini beans, drained

stages.title: Soften the base
steps: Warm oil in a deep pot over medium-low heat and add onion, carrots and celery.
Stir occasionally for 10–12 minutes until tender but not browned.

stages.title: Build the broth
steps: Add garlic and rosemary and cook for one minute until fragrant.
Stir in drained beans and stock, scraping the bottom of the pot.

stages.title: Simmer and thicken
steps: Simmer gently for 15 minutes, then mash a ladleful of beans against the pot to thicken the broth.
Add chopped kale and cook for five minutes until soft but still green.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Remove the rosemary stem and stir in lemon juice.
Taste for salt and pepper and serve with toasted sourdough.

tips: Mash some beans instead of adding flour for natural thickness.
Add kale near the end to preserve its colour.
variations: Add a Parmesan rind during simmering, then discard.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.

title: Brazilian Black Bean Feijoada
summary: Rich Brazilian black bean stew with slow-cooked pork, smoky sausage and fragrant seasonings.

stages.title: Brown the meats
steps: Heat oil in a heavy pot and brown pork shoulder and sausage in batches.
Transfer to a plate, leaving a little rendered fat in the pot.

stages.title: Build the bean base
steps: Cook chopped onion until soft, then add garlic and bay leaves.
Return meats, add drained beans and water, and bring to a gentle simmer.

stages.title: Simmer until tender
steps: Cover loosely and cook until pork is tender, stirring and adding water as needed.
Mash a spoonful of beans into the broth for a thicker texture.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Cook rice while the stew finishes and taste the beans for seasoning.
Serve feijoada with rice and orange wedges to cut through the richness.

tips: Use smoked sausage for depth; salt only after tasting.
The sauce should be thick enough to coat the beans.
variations: Add collard greens on the side.
Use cooked dried beans instead of canned for a longer traditional preparation.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.

title: Indian Chana Masala
summary: Tender chickpeas in a tangy tomato curry with ginger, cumin and garam masala.

stages.title: Soften onion
steps: Heat oil in a deep frying pan and cook onion until golden at the edges.
Add garlic and ginger and stir until fragrant without scorching.

stages.title: Cook spice masala
steps: Add cumin, coriander, turmeric and tomatoes.
Cook until tomatoes soften and the mixture becomes thick and glossy.

stages.title: Simmer chickpeas
steps: Add drained chickpeas and water, then simmer gently until flavours combine.
Mash a few chickpeas against the side to naturally thicken the sauce.

stages.title: Finish with garam masala
steps: Stir in garam masala and adjust salt and acidity.
Serve with basmati rice, roti or warm naan.

tips: Cook the tomato mixture until the raw taste disappears.
Add garam masala near the end for fragrance.
variations: Finish with lemon juice and coriander.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.

title: Vietnamese Lemongrass Pork Bowls
summary: Caramelised lemongrass pork served over rice with crunchy pickles, herbs and a savoury dressing.

stages.title: Marinate pork
steps: Mix minced tender lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce, sugar and lime juice.
Toss with thin pork slices and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes.

stages.title: Cook rice and vegetables
steps: Rinse and cook rice according to the packet, then leave covered to rest.
Julienne carrot and slice cucumber thinly for a crisp topping.

stages.title: Sear pork
steps: Heat oil in a heavy pan until hot and cook pork in small batches.
Let slices brown before turning and cook until no raw pork remains.

stages.title: Assemble bowls
steps: Fluff rice into bowls and top with hot lemongrass pork.
Add cucumber, carrot and extra lime, keeping crunchy vegetables separate.

tips: Use only the tender inner lemongrass stalks.
Cook pork in batches for caramelised edges.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.

title: Greek Gigantes Plaki
summary: Giant butter beans baked in a herby tomato sauce until creamy and deeply savoury.
ingredients: 2 x 400 g tins butter beans, drained

stages.title: Make aromatic base
steps: Heat olive oil in an ovenproof pan and soften diced onion and carrots.
Add garlic, oregano and tomato paste and cook for another minute.

stages.title: Build tomato sauce
steps: Add chopped tomatoes and a splash of water and simmer until slightly reduced.
Taste for salt and pepper before adding the beans.

stages.title: Bake beans
steps: Fold in drained butter beans gently and transfer to a baking dish if needed.
Bake uncovered at 190°C until bubbling and the sauce clings to the beans.

stages.title: Rest and finish
steps: Let beans cool for 10 minutes so the sauce thickens.
Scatter with fresh dill and serve warm or at room temperature.

tips: Avoid stirring vigorously so the large beans stay intact.
A generous amount of olive oil gives the classic silky finish.
variations: Serve with feta and crusty bread.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.

title: Korean Cucumber Salad Oi Muchim
summary: Crunchy cucumber dressed with Korean chilli flakes, garlic, sesame and rice vinegar.

stages.title: Slice cucumbers
steps: Cut cucumbers into thin rounds or half-moons.
Toss with salt in a colander and leave for 10 minutes to draw out moisture.

stages.title: Drain and dry
steps: Rinse lightly if very salty, then pat cucumbers dry with kitchen paper.
Drying prevents the dressing becoming diluted.

stages.title: Mix spicy dressing
steps: Stir gochugaru, vinegar, soy sauce, sugar and sesame oil until combined.
Slice spring onion finely and add it to the dressing.

stages.title: Toss and serve
steps: Coat cucumbers evenly and sprinkle sesame seeds on top.
Serve promptly while crisp, or chill briefly before eating.

tips: Salting keeps cucumbers crunchy.
Dress close to serving to avoid excess liquid.
variations: Use less gochugaru for a mild salad.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.

title: Middle Eastern Fattoush Salad
summary: Crisp lettuce, cucumber, tomatoes and toasted pita with a lemony sumac dressing.

stages.title: Toast pita
steps: Cut pita into bite-sized triangles and brush lightly with olive oil.
Bake at 190°C for 8–10 minutes until crisp and golden.

stages.title: Chop salad
steps: Dice tomatoes and cucumber, slice radishes and spring onions, and tear lettuce.
Dry washed leaves thoroughly so the dressing clings.

stages.title: Make dressing
steps: Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, sumac and dried mint with salt.
Taste and adjust lemon for a bright, sharp finish.

stages.title: Toss at the end
steps: Combine vegetables and dressing just before serving.
Fold in toasted pita last to preserve its crunch.

tips: Add toasted bread only at the last moment.
Sumac supplies a distinctive tart flavour.
variations: Use pomegranate molasses in the dressing.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.

title: Chinese Smashed Cucumber Salad
summary: Smashed cucumber pieces tossed in garlicky soy-vinegar dressing with sesame and chilli.

stages.title: Smash cucumbers
steps: Lay cucumbers on a board and gently crush along their length with a rolling pin.
Tear into irregular bite-sized pieces so the dressing catches in the cracks.

stages.title: Salt and drain
steps: Sprinkle with a pinch of salt and leave in a colander for 10 minutes.
Pat dry to prevent a watery salad.

stages.title: Mix dressing
steps: Whisk vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, chilli oil, sugar and grated garlic.
Taste and adjust acidity or sweetness to preference.

stages.title: Dress and serve
steps: Toss cucumber pieces in dressing until evenly coated.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve immediately.

tips: Irregular smashed edges absorb dressing better than neat slices.
Drain cucumbers well before seasoning.
variations: Omit chilli oil for a mild version.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.

title: Mexican Elote Street Corn
summary: Charred sweetcorn coated in tangy lime crema, chilli and crumbly cheese.

stages.title: Prepare corn
steps: Remove husks and silk and pat corn dry.
Heat a barbecue or grill pan to medium-high.

stages.title: Char the cobs
steps: Grill corn, turning every few minutes, until kernels are tender and spotted with char.
Move cobs away from direct heat if they begin to burn.

stages.title: Mix creamy topping
steps: Stir mayonnaise and sour cream together with a squeeze of lime.
Crumble cheese and finely chop coriander for serving.

stages.title: Coat and finish
steps: Brush hot corn generously with the creamy mixture.
Roll in cheese, dust with chilli powder and finish with lime and coriander.

tips: Char adds smoky flavour; do not burn the kernels black.
Dress while corn is hot.
variations: Cut kernels off for elote cups.
Use smoked paprika instead of chilli.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.

title: French Croque Madame
summary: Golden toasted ham and cheese topped with creamy béchamel and a sunny fried egg.

stages.title: Make béchamel
steps: Melt butter in a saucepan, stir in flour and cook for one minute.
Gradually whisk in milk and simmer until smooth and thick, then add mustard.

stages.title: Assemble sandwiches
steps: Layer ham and grated Gruyère between bread slices.
Spread a thin layer of béchamel on top and scatter over remaining cheese.

stages.title: Grill until golden
steps: Place sandwiches under a medium grill until bread is toasted and cheese bubbles.
Watch carefully so the sauce browns without burning.

stages.title: Top with eggs
steps: Fry eggs in a little oil until whites are fully set.
Place one egg on each sandwich and serve hot.

tips: A thick béchamel stays on top rather than soaking bread.
Gruyère melts smoothly.
variations: Use wholegrain mustard instead of Dijon.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.

title: Scottish Porridge with Stewed Apples
summary: Creamy porridge with gently stewed cinnamon apples and a touch of brown sugar.

stages.title: Stew apples
steps: Melt butter in a small pan and add diced apples, cinnamon and a splash of water.
Cover and cook until apples soften but still hold their shape.

stages.title: Start porridge
steps: Combine oats, milk, water and salt in a heavy saucepan.
Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat, stirring regularly.

stages.title: Cook until creamy
steps: Reduce heat and simmer oats until soft and thick, adding milk if needed.
Stir frequently to prevent the base catching.

stages.title: Serve warm
steps: Divide porridge among bowls and spoon over warm apples.
Drizzle with maple syrup and serve immediately.

tips: Low heat produces creamy oats without scorching.
A pinch of salt balances the sweetness.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.

title: American Breakfast Burritos
summary: Warm tortillas filled with scrambled eggs, crispy potatoes, beans and salsa.

stages.title: Crisp potatoes
steps: Heat oil in a skillet and cook small potato cubes until golden and tender.
Add diced capsicum for the final five minutes and season lightly.

stages.title: Scramble eggs
steps: Beat eggs with a pinch of salt and cook gently in a nonstick pan.
Fold until just set and remove from heat before they dry out.

stages.title: Fill tortillas
steps: Warm tortillas briefly to make them flexible.
Divide potatoes, eggs, warmed beans, cheese, salsa and avocado among them.

stages.title: Roll and toast
steps: Fold the sides inward and roll tightly from the bottom.
Toast seam-side down in a dry pan until lightly crisp, then serve.

tips: Keep fillings relatively dry to prevent soggy tortillas.
Warm tortillas before rolling to avoid tears.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.

title: Greek Spanakopita Triangles
summary: Crisp filo triangles stuffed with spinach, salty feta and fresh dill.

stages.title: Cook spinach filling
steps: Soften finely chopped onion in a little butter, then add spinach until wilted.
Cool and squeeze out excess moisture thoroughly.

stages.title: Mix filling
steps: Crumble feta into spinach and stir in eggs, dill and pepper.
Taste before adding salt because feta is already salty.

stages.title: Fold triangles
steps: Cut filo sheets into long strips and brush lightly with melted butter.
Place a spoonful of filling at one end and fold repeatedly into neat triangles.

stages.title: Bake until crisp
steps: Arrange on a lined tray and brush tops with remaining butter.
Bake at 190°C conventional for 20–25 minutes until deeply golden; cool briefly.

tips: Squeeze spinach very dry to keep pastry crisp.
Cover unused filo with a damp tea towel.
variations: Use ricotta for part of the feta.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.

title: Mexican Chicken Tostadas
summary: Crunchy tostadas layered with seasoned chicken, beans, lettuce, salsa and crema.

stages.title: Crisp tortillas
steps: Brush tortillas lightly with oil and bake at 200°C until crisp, turning halfway.
Cool on a rack so steam does not soften them.

stages.title: Warm filling
steps: Heat refried beans in a saucepan with a splash of water until spreadable.
Warm shredded chicken separately until steaming hot and season with lime.

stages.title: Prepare toppings
steps: Dice tomatoes, shred lettuce and slice avocado just before assembling.
Crumble cheese and keep salsa ready.

stages.title: Assemble and serve
steps: Spread beans on each crisp tortilla, then layer chicken and vegetables.
Finish with salsa, cheese and lime and serve immediately.

tips: Assemble just before serving to keep tortillas crisp.
Warm beans make an effective base layer.
variations: Use black beans instead of refried beans.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.

title: Chinese Scallion Pancakes Cong You Bing
summary: Pan-fried Chinese flatbreads with flaky layers, crisp edges and fragrant spring onions.

stages.title: Make hot-water dough
steps: Pour hot water gradually into flour and stir with chopsticks until shaggy.
Knead once cool enough to handle until smooth, then cover.

stages.title: Rest and roll
steps: Rest dough for 30 minutes to relax the gluten.
Divide into four pieces and roll each into a thin rectangle.

stages.title: Layer spring onions
steps: Brush each rectangle with oil, sprinkle salt and finely chopped spring onions.
Roll into a log, coil into a spiral and flatten gently with a rolling pin.

stages.title: Pan-fry crisp
steps: Heat a thin layer of oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Fry pancakes 3–4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through, then cut into wedges.

tips: Resting makes the dough easier to roll.
Medium heat cooks the centre before the outside burns.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.

title: Moroccan Carrot and Orange Salad
summary: Sweet carrots and juicy orange segments tossed with cumin, cinnamon and fresh herbs.

stages.title: Cook carrots
steps: Peel and cut carrots into thin diagonal slices.
Simmer in lightly salted water until just tender, then drain and cool slightly.

stages.title: Prepare oranges
steps: Peel oranges, removing the white pith, and cut into segments over a bowl.
Reserve any juice released for the dressing.

stages.title: Mix spiced dressing
steps: Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, honey, cumin, cinnamon and reserved orange juice.
Taste for a balance of sweet, tart and warm spice.

stages.title: Toss and finish
steps: Combine carrots and orange segments gently with dressing.
Scatter parsley and toasted almonds over the top before serving.

tips: Do not overcook carrots; retain a little bite.
Reserve orange juice to flavour dressing.
variations: Use fresh mint instead of parsley.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.

title: German Warm Potato Salad
summary: Tender warm potatoes with bacon, mustard, onion and tangy vinegar dressing.

stages.title: Boil potatoes
steps: Cook whole potatoes in salted water until tender but not falling apart.
Drain and cool just enough to handle, then slice thickly.

stages.title: Crisp bacon
steps: Fry diced bacon in a wide pan until golden and crisp.
Remove bacon and soften diced red onion in a little of the rendered fat.

stages.title: Make warm dressing
steps: Add vinegar, mustard, stock and sugar to the pan and simmer briefly.
Scrape up any browned bits and taste for acidity.

stages.title: Dress potatoes
steps: Fold warm potato slices into dressing gently until coated.
Return bacon, scatter parsley and serve while warm.

tips: Dress potatoes while warm so they absorb flavour.
Use waxy varieties that hold their shape.
variations: Omit bacon and use olive oil.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.

title: American Macaroni Salad
summary: Tender macaroni with crunchy celery, peppers and a creamy, tangy dressing.

stages.title: Cook macaroni
steps: Boil macaroni in salted water until just tender according to packet directions.
Drain, rinse briefly under cold water and let cool completely.

stages.title: Chop vegetables
steps: Finely dice celery, carrot, capsicum and spring onions.
Keep pieces small so every forkful has an even mix.

stages.title: Mix dressing
steps: Whisk mayonnaise, vinegar, mustard and sugar with salt and pepper.
Taste for a slightly tangy balance before adding pasta.

stages.title: Combine and chill
steps: Toss cooled macaroni and vegetables with dressing until coated.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes and stir before serving.

tips: Cool pasta before adding mayonnaise.
Small vegetable dice give a better texture.
variations: Use Greek yoghurt for part of mayonnaise.
storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 3 days. Keep chilled when serving outdoors; do not leave at room temperature.

title: Thai Mango Sticky Rice
summary: Sweet coconut sticky rice topped with ripe mango and a drizzle of salted coconut cream.

stages.title: Soak sticky rice
steps: Rinse glutinous rice until water runs mostly clear, then soak in cool water for at least two hours.
Drain thoroughly before steaming.

stages.title: Steam rice
steps: Line a steamer with muslin and spread rice in an even layer.
Steam over simmering water until grains are tender and translucent, about 20–25 minutes.

stages.title: Sweeten with coconut
steps: Warm coconut milk, sugar and salt until dissolved, reserving a little sauce for serving.
Fold most coconut mixture into hot rice, cover and rest 10 minutes to absorb.

stages.title: Serve with mango
steps: Peel and slice mangoes into neat pieces.
Serve sticky rice with mango, reserved coconut sauce and sesame seeds.

tips: Use glutinous rice, not ordinary jasmine rice.
Allow hot rice time to absorb coconut sauce.
variations: Add toasted mung beans for crunch.
storage: Refrigerate promptly and eat within 24 hours. Reheat rice thoroughly; keep sliced mango separate.

title: Italian Lemon Ricotta Cake
summary: Tender lemon cake enriched with ricotta, bright citrus zest and a delicate golden crust.

stages.title: Prepare tin and ingredients
steps: Heat oven to 175°C conventional and line a 20 cm round cake tin.
Drain watery ricotta briefly and zest lemons finely.

stages.title: Cream butter and sugar
steps: Beat softened butter and sugar until pale, then beat in eggs one at a time.
Mix in ricotta, vanilla, lemon zest and juice until just combined.

stages.title: Fold and bake
steps: Sift flour and baking powder over the mixture and fold gently.
Spoon into tin and bake 40–45 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.

stages.title: Cool before slicing
steps: Cool in tin for 15 minutes, then transfer to a rack.
Dust lightly with icing sugar when completely cool.

tips: Drain excess liquid from ricotta for a lighter crumb.
Avoid overmixing the flour.
variations: Use orange zest instead of lemon.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.

title: American Banana Bread
summary: Moist banana loaf with a soft crumb, caramelised sweetness and warm vanilla notes.

stages.title: Prepare batter base
steps: Heat oven to 175°C conventional and line a loaf tin.
Mash ripe bananas until mostly smooth and stir in melted cooled butter.

stages.title: Mix wet ingredients
steps: Whisk brown sugar, eggs and vanilla into banana mixture.
Stir until combined without trying to make it airy.

stages.title: Add dry ingredients
steps: Fold flour, bicarbonate, cinnamon and salt into wet mixture.
Stop as soon as no dry flour remains to avoid a tough loaf.

stages.title: Bake and cool
steps: Bake 50–60 minutes until the centre springs back and a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in tin for 10 minutes, then transfer to a rack before slicing.

tips: Very ripe bananas give better sweetness and flavour.
Do not overmix after adding flour.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.

title: Portuguese Arroz Doce
summary: Creamy Portuguese rice pudding scented with lemon peel and cinnamon.

stages.title: Start rice gently
steps: Simmer rice with water, lemon peel, cinnamon and salt until most water is absorbed.
Stir occasionally to prevent sticking and keep the heat low.

stages.title: Add milk
steps: Warm milk separately and add gradually to rice while stirring.
Cook gently until grains are tender and mixture creamy.

stages.title: Enrich pudding
steps: Stir in sugar, then temper egg yolks with a little warm pudding in a bowl.
Return yolk mixture to pot over low heat and stir until thickened without boiling.

stages.title: Serve and cool
steps: Remove cinnamon stick and lemon peel and divide pudding into bowls.
Dust with cinnamon and serve warm or chilled.

tips: Avoid boiling after adding yolks to prevent curdling.
Short-grain rice creates a creamy texture.
variations: Omit yolks for a lighter pudding.
storage: Cool promptly and refrigerate up to 2 days; keep cooked rice chilled.

title: Indian Gajar Halwa
summary: Slow-cooked grated carrots with milk, cardamom, ghee and nuts for a rich Indian dessert.

stages.title: Cook carrots in milk
steps: Place finely grated carrots and milk in a wide heavy pan.
Simmer uncovered, stirring often, until carrots soften and milk mostly reduces.

stages.title: Add ghee and sugar
steps: Stir in ghee and sugar and continue cooking over medium-low heat.
Keep stirring as mixture thickens to prevent scorching.

stages.title: Finish with spice
steps: Add cardamom and raisins and cook until glossy and spoonable.
Taste for sweetness and add a little more sugar only if needed.

stages.title: Toast nuts and serve
steps: Toast cashews in a dry pan until lightly golden.
Scatter over warm halwa and serve in small bowls.

tips: Use a wide pan to speed milk reduction.
Stir frequently during the final thickening.
variations: Use a little condensed milk and reduce sugar.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.

title: Spanish Basque Burnt Cheesecake
summary: Deeply caramelised cheesecake with a dark burnt top and soft, custardy centre.

stages.title: Prepare deep tin
steps: Heat oven to 220°C conventional and line a 20 cm springform tin with two large crumpled parchment sheets.
Let paper extend above the rim to contain the rising batter.

stages.title: Mix smooth filling
steps: Beat cream cheese and sugar until completely smooth.
Add eggs one at a time, then cream, vanilla, salt and sifted flour.

stages.title: Bake dark on top
steps: Pour batter into lined tin and bake 35–40 minutes until top is deeply browned.
The centre should still wobble noticeably when the tin is nudged.

stages.title: Cool and chill
steps: Cool at room temperature until no longer hot, then refrigerate at least four hours.
Remove parchment carefully and slice with a warm knife.

tips: The dark top is intentional; the centre should remain creamy.
Room-temperature cream cheese prevents lumps.
storage: Refrigerate covered up to 3 days. Do not leave at room temperature for prolonged periods.

title: Australian Lamingtons
summary: Soft chocolate-coated sponge squares rolled in desiccated coconut, often filled with jam and cream.

stages.title: Bake sponge
steps: Heat oven to 180°C conventional and line a 20 cm square tin.
Cream butter and sugar, beat in eggs, then fold in flour, baking powder, milk and vanilla; bake until a skewer comes out clean.

stages.title: Cool and cube
steps: Cool sponge completely, then chill briefly to firm the crumb.
Cut into 16 even squares with a sharp serrated knife.

stages.title: Make chocolate coating
steps: Whisk icing sugar and cocoa with enough warm water to make a smooth, pourable glaze.
Place coconut in a wide shallow dish ready for dipping.

stages.title: Dip and set
steps: Dip each cake cube quickly in chocolate glaze using forks, letting excess drip off.
Roll in coconut and place on a rack until coating sets.

tips: Chilled sponge crumbles less during dipping.
Keep glaze fluid enough for a thin coating.
variations: Split and fill with raspberry jam.
Use toasted coconut for a nuttier finish.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.

title: Greek Baklava
summary: Crisp layers of filo, nuts and butter soaked in fragrant honey syrup.

stages.title: Prepare nut filling
steps: Heat oven to 175°C conventional and finely chop nuts without turning them to powder.
Mix nuts with cinnamon and butter a rectangular baking dish.

stages.title: Layer filo
steps: Lay half the filo sheets in the dish, brushing each lightly with melted butter.
Scatter nut mixture evenly, then layer remaining filo with butter between sheets.

stages.title: Cut and bake
steps: Score the top into diamonds before baking so the crisp pastry does not shatter later.
Bake 40–45 minutes until deeply golden and crisp.

stages.title: Pour cooled syrup
steps: Simmer sugar, water, honey and lemon peel for 10 minutes, then cool slightly.
Pour warm syrup over hot baklava gradually and let stand until absorbed.

tips: Keep unused filo covered to prevent drying.
Cut pastry before baking for neat portions.
variations: Add orange blossom water to syrup.
storage: Store airtight in a cool place up to 3 days or refrigerate up to 5 days; pastry softens in the fridge.

title: Japanese Matcha Panna Cotta
summary: Delicate matcha-infused cream dessert with a smooth set and subtle earthy sweetness.

stages.title: Bloom gelatin
steps: Soak gelatin leaves in cold water until soft.
Sift matcha powder into a small bowl to remove lumps.

stages.title: Heat cream base
steps: Warm cream, milk, sugar and vanilla gently until steaming but not boiling.
Whisk a little warm cream into matcha to make a smooth paste, then return it to the pan.

stages.title: Dissolve and chill
steps: Remove from heat and stir in squeezed gelatin until completely dissolved.
Divide among four glasses and refrigerate for at least four hours until softly set.

stages.title: Garnish and serve
steps: Slice strawberries thinly and pat dry.
Place on chilled panna cotta just before serving.

tips: Sift matcha to avoid green lumps.
Do not boil gelatin mixture.
variations: Add a little white chocolate to the cream.
storage: Refrigerate covered up to 3 days. Add fruit just before serving.

title: Georgian Khachapuri Cheese Bread
summary: Boat-shaped Georgian bread filled with molten cheese, butter and a soft egg yolk.

stages.title: Make dough
steps: Combine flour, yeast, sugar, water and salt into a soft dough.
Knead with oil until smooth and elastic.

stages.title: Proof dough
steps: Cover and leave warm until doubled.
Mix crumbled feta with grated mozzarella.

stages.title: Shape boats
steps: Divide dough into two ovals and roll the long edges inward to make raised rims.
Fill centres with cheese and pinch the ends into points.

stages.title: Bake and finish
steps: Bake at 220°C until golden and bubbling.
Crack an egg into each centre for the last few minutes and cook until whites are set.

tips: Pinch boat ends firmly to hold filling.
Use a hot oven for crisp edges.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.

title: Egyptian Koshari
summary: Egyptian comfort food layering rice, lentils and pasta with spicy tomato sauce and crisp onions.

stages.title: Cook grains
steps: Simmer lentils until tender and cook rice separately according to packet directions.
Boil macaroni in salted water until al dente.

stages.title: Crisp onions
steps: Thinly slice onions and fry in oil over medium heat until deep golden.
Drain on paper and reserve a little flavoured oil.

stages.title: Make tomato sauce
steps: Cook garlic and cumin in reserved oil, then add tomatoes and vinegar.
Simmer until thick and tangy, adjusting salt.

stages.title: Layer and serve
steps: Layer rice, lentils and macaroni in bowls.
Spoon over tomato sauce and finish with crisp onions.

tips: Drain onions well to retain crunch.
Keep tomato sauce tangy to balance starches.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.

title: Persian Zereshk Polo with Chicken
summary: Saffron chicken served with fragrant Persian rice and tart ruby-red barberries.

stages.title: Brown chicken
steps: Season chicken with turmeric and salt and brown in oil.
Add sliced onion and cook until softened.

stages.title: Braise gently
steps: Add 200 ml water, cover and simmer until chicken reaches 75°C.
Reduce sauce uncovered if watery.

stages.title: Steam saffron rice
steps: Rinse and cook basmati rice until just tender.
Bloom saffron in warm water and fold into a portion of rice.

stages.title: Warm barberries
steps: Briefly warm barberries in butter and sugar without burning.
Serve chicken with rice and scatter barberries and saffron rice over the top.

tips: Barberries scorch quickly; use gentle heat.
Bloom saffron for even colour.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.

title: Polish Pierogi Ruskie
summary: Tender Polish dumplings filled with potato, cheese and onion, served with buttery fried onions.

stages.title: Make dough
steps: Mix flour, water, egg and salt into a supple dough.
Knead until smooth and cover to rest.

stages.title: Prepare filling
steps: Boil potatoes until tender, drain and mash thoroughly.
Fry chopped onion in butter and combine half with potato and cheese.

stages.title: Fill dumplings
steps: Roll dough thinly and cut rounds with a glass.
Add filling, fold into half-moons and seal edges firmly.

stages.title: Boil and serve
steps: Boil pierogi in salted water until they float and cook another two minutes.
Drain and toss with remaining buttery onions.

tips: Seal edges without trapping air.
Keep unfilled dough covered.
variations: Pan-fry boiled pierogi for crisp edges.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.

title: Swedish Meatballs with Cream Sauce
summary: Tender Swedish meatballs coated in a silky cream gravy, traditionally served with potatoes and lingonberries.

stages.title: Mix meatballs
steps: Soak breadcrumbs in milk and finely grate onion.
Mix with mince, egg and allspice just until combined.

stages.title: Shape and brown
steps: Roll into small even balls and brown in butter over medium heat.
Turn gently and work in batches to avoid overcrowding.

stages.title: Simmer in sauce
steps: Pour stock into pan and scrape up browned bits.
Add cream, return meatballs and simmer until cooked through.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Taste sauce and season with salt and pepper.
Serve with mashed potatoes and lingonberry jam if available.

tips: Avoid overworking mince for tender meatballs.
Use small equal balls for even cooking.
variations: Add Dijon mustard to cream sauce.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.

title: Danish Æbleskiver Pancake Balls
summary: Small round Danish pancake puffs with golden shells and soft centres, served with jam and sugar.

stages.title: Mix batter
steps: Separate eggs and whisk yolks with buttermilk and melted butter.
Fold in flour, sugar, baking powder and cardamom.

stages.title: Whip whites
steps: Beat egg whites to soft peaks.
Fold gently into batter to keep it airy.

stages.title: Cook in mould
steps: Oil an æbleskiver pan and fill each hollow three-quarters full.
Turn balls gradually with a skewer until golden and cooked in the middle.

stages.title: Serve warm
steps: Transfer to a plate and dust with icing sugar.
Serve immediately with berry jam.

tips: Turn balls in stages to form rounded shapes.
Avoid overfilling moulds.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.

title: Filipino Turon Banana Rolls
summary: Crispy caramelised banana spring rolls with a sweet filling and golden pastry shell.

stages.title: Prepare banana
steps: Peel bananas and cut each lengthwise into two pieces.
Mix brown sugar with cinnamon in a shallow dish.

stages.title: Wrap rolls
steps: Roll each banana piece in sugar mixture and place on a wrapper.
Fold sides inward and roll tightly, sealing the edge with water.

stages.title: Fry until golden
steps: Heat oil over medium heat and fry rolls in batches.
Turn until wrappers are crisp and sugar inside caramelises.

stages.title: Drain and serve
steps: Drain briefly on a rack rather than stacking hot rolls.
Serve warm, taking care as the caramel filling is very hot.

tips: Use firm ripe bananas that hold shape.
Let filling cool slightly before eating.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.

title: Nepalese Aloo Tama Bamboo Shoot Curry
summary: Tangy Nepalese curry of potatoes and bamboo shoots simmered with beans and aromatic spices.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Peel and cube potatoes evenly and rinse bamboo shoots to moderate their sourness.
Dice onion and tomatoes and mince garlic.

stages.title: Cook aromatics
steps: Heat oil in a pot and soften onion until translucent.
Add garlic, cumin and turmeric and stir briefly until fragrant.

stages.title: Simmer curry
steps: Add potatoes, bamboo shoots, tomatoes and water and bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook until potatoes are tender and the broth is lightly thickened.

stages.title: Balance and serve
steps: Taste the curry and adjust salt, adding water if overly concentrated.
Serve hot with rice and fresh coriander if desired.

tips: Rinse strongly fermented bamboo shoots before cooking.
Potatoes should be tender but hold shape.
variations: Use fresh green chilli for heat.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly where appropriate.
